summary: Transitional quarter marked by employment change and strategic repositioning. PPI volatile but stable (averaged 95.8, ended 98.75). PWI declined 29% due to job transition. Longform Media Velocity averaged 11.3 points/month. Foundation-setting period with mixed signals.
highlights: Strong January productivity (PPI 102.5) followed by February adjustment
Employment transition drove PWI decline of 29% over the quarter
Exceptional reading/viewing in January (20 points) not sustained
March showed recovery signs: PPI back to 98.75, media engagement at 11 points
Three indicators (KBER, SCI, PHI) not yet tracking in Q1 period
